content:
Aisha (Product Designer): Quick design question — can we simplify the network step by collapsing the egress probe details behind a `Show details` expander? Users get overloaded by log noise.

Tom (Engineer): I get the motivation. Concern: hiding failure details makes debugging slower for SREs. Maybe surface a one-line summary + expand for full logs.

Kofi (Accessibility): If we add an expander, it must be keyboard focusable and announce the expanded/collapsed state (aria-expanded). Also the trigger label should say what will be revealed (e.g., 'Show full probe output').

Aisha (Product Designer): Proposal: top-line status pill (Success / Action required) + single-line hint with an inline error icon. Then a chevron "Show full probe output" that expands to the copyable log. Keeps vertical density low on small screens.

Marcus (DevEx): +1. Also include a small "Try these fixes" block when action is required with links to docs and a Retry button inline. Example copy: "Try these fixes: open port 443, allow egress to model-hosts.redwood.ai" with a KB link.

Tom (Engineer): Implementation notes: keep the expanded logs in a `pre` block and add a copy button. Avoid scroll traps — allow the panel to grow up to 400px then scroll. Sample snippet:
```
[egress] tcp 8.8.8.8:443 => timeout after 5s
Suggested: check outbound firewall for your subnet
```

Kofi (Accessibility): Also don't rely on color alone for the status pill. Use an icon + text and ensure contrast (check AA). For live regions: announce status changes so AT users know when a probe completes.

Aisha (Product Designer): Sounds good. I'll update the mock to use: pill + one-line hint + chevron, expanded pre with copy + KB link + Retry. Moving probe timestamp into the details to reduce clutter on the primary step.

Marta (PM): No objections. Make sure telemetry still records per-probe timing and expanded/collapsed events for metrics.

Deploy Bot: Deployment queued for branch ux/compact-conn-hints by aisha — CI passed :white_check_mark:

Tom (Engineer): One more ask — add an optional "Show raw command" for power users so they can re-run probes locally (e.g., `curl`/`nc` line).
_note: Each message is in chronological order and prefixed with the sender's name per agents.md
